tasks.title: Ascending sort
tasks.statement: Output the title and price of products from cheapest to most expensive (ORDER BY price).
tasks.hint: ORDER BY price sorts in ascending order.

tasks.title: Descending sort
tasks.statement: Output the title and price of products from most expensive to cheapest (DESC). The products have different prices.

tasks.title: Sorting text
tasks.statement: Output the name of customers in alphabetical order.

tasks.title: Reverse alphabet
tasks.statement: Output the name of customers in reverse alphabetical order.

tasks.title: Sorting by date
tasks.statement: Output the id and created of orders from newest to oldest.
tasks.hint: Dates in YYYY-MM-DD format sort correctly as strings. For equal dates, add id DESC.

tasks.title: Sorting by two columns
tasks.statement: Output the city and name of customers: first by city, within a city by name (ORDER BY city, name).
tasks.hint: The second column applies when the first is equal.

tasks.title: Different directions
tasks.statement: Output category, title, price: categories alphabetically, within a category the expensive ones first.
tasks.hint: ORDER BY category, price DESC: the direction is set for each column.

tasks.title: By expression
tasks.statement: Output the title and the stock value (price * stock) as stock_value; the most valuable stock first.
tasks.hint: You can sort by the alias.

tasks.title: By column number
tasks.statement: Output title, price, sorted by the second column of the list (ORDER BY 2) in descending order; the prices are distinct.
tasks.hint: ORDER BY 2 sorts by the second column of the result.

tasks.title: Sorting by a column not shown
tasks.statement: Output only the title of products, sorted by price (price) in ascending order. You can sort by a column that is not in the result.

tasks.title: NULL in sorting
tasks.statement: Output the name and city of customers, sorted by city ascending, then by name. In SQLite, NULL is considered the smallest value and comes first.

tasks.title: NULL last
tasks.statement: Output the name and city of customers ordered by city, but with NULL cities at the end: first ORDER BY city IS NULL, then city, name.
tasks.hint: city IS NULL equals 0 for filled values and 1 for empty ones.

tasks.title: Filter and sort
tasks.statement: Output the title and price of products cheaper than 5000, the most expensive first (WHERE first, then ORDER BY).
tasks.hint: Word order: SELECT … FROM … WHERE … ORDER BY …

tasks.title: First three
tasks.statement: Output the three most expensive products: title and price (ORDER BY price DESC LIMIT 3).
tasks.hint: LIMIT restricts the number of rows.

tasks.title: The cheapest
tasks.statement: Output the cheapest product (title, price).

tasks.title: Newest order
tasks.statement: Output the id and created of the most recent order (for equal dates, the one with the larger id).

tasks.title: Earliest customer
tasks.statement: Output the name and registered of the earliest customer by registration date.

tasks.title: Five biggest orders
tasks.statement: Output the id and total of the five largest orders (the amounts are distinct).

tasks.title: Skip rows
tasks.statement: OFFSET skips rows. Output the id, name of customers in ascending id order, skipping the first three and taking the next four.

tasks.title: Page 1
tasks.statement: Paged output of 5 products each, sorted by id. Output page 1: id and title.

tasks.title: Page 2
tasks.statement: Output page 2 (5 products per page, sorted by id): id and title.

tasks.title: Page 3
tasks.statement: Output page 3 (5 products per page, sorted by id): id and title. The page is not full.

tasks.title: Second by price
tasks.statement: Output the product that is second by price (title, price): ORDER BY price DESC, skip one row, take one.

tasks.title: Three cheapest in a category
tasks.statement: Output the title, price of the three cheapest products in the category `'Продукты'` (by ascending price).

tasks.title: Latest registrations
tasks.statement: Output the name and registered of the three customers who registered last (newest first).

tasks.title: Distinct and ordered
tasks.statement: Output the distinct product categories in alphabetical order (DISTINCT and ORDER BY together).

tasks.title: Cities descending
tasks.statement: Output the distinct non-empty customer cities in reverse alphabetical order.
tasks.hint: IS NOT NULL filters out missing values.

tasks.title: Warehouse: least stock
tasks.statement: Output the title and stock of the five products with the smallest stock; ties broken by title.

tasks.title: Two sort keys
tasks.statement: Output the status and total of orders: by status alphabetically, within a status the large orders first; id last for stability.
tasks.hint: The third key, id, makes the order unambiguous.

tasks.title: Top by title length
tasks.statement: Output the title and length(title) as len for the three longest product titles (by length descending, then by title).
tasks.hint: length(string) is the number of characters.

tasks.title: Order lines
tasks.statement: Table order_items. Output order_id, product_id, qty, price by qty descending, then by order_id, product_id; the first 5 rows.

tasks.title: Salaries descending
tasks.statement: HR database. Output the name and salary of the five highest-paid employees (the salaries are distinct).

tasks.title: Long-timers
tasks.statement: HR database. Output the name and hired of the three employees who have worked at the company the longest.

tasks.title: Employees by department
tasks.statement: HR database. Output dept_id, name, salary: by department, within a department by salary descending, then by name. The NULL department comes first.

tasks.title: Best scores
tasks.statement: School database. Output student_id, course_id, score for the year 2024: by score descending (NULL last), then by student_id, course_id; the first 6 rows.

tasks.title: Youngest students
tasks.statement: School database. Output the name and birth of the three youngest students (the latest birth dates).

tasks.title: Movies by rating
tasks.statement: Movies database. Output the title and rating of movies by rating descending; movies without a rating at the end. The first 5.

tasks.title: Biggest budgets
tasks.statement: Movies database. Output the title and budget of the three movies with the biggest budget.

tasks.title: Chronology
tasks.statement: Movies database. Output the title and year by ascending year, ties broken by title.
